# Casa OM del Sur — Playa La Ropa Condo Rental

Casa OM del Sur is a luxury 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom vacation rental condo in the Punta Marina complex at Playa La Ropa, Zihuatanejo, Mexico, overlooking the bay.

## The condo

- 3 king bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroom and rain shower
- Fully equipped galley kitchen: gas stove, air fryer, fridge, cookware, tableware
- Huge covered patio overlooking the bay, with private BBQ and three sitting areas
- Shared swimming pool with chaises in the Punta Marina complex
- All bed linens, bath towels, and beach towels included
- High-speed WiFi; water, gas, and electricity included
- Sleeps up to 6 guests

## Location

#103 Punta Marina, Playa La Ropa, Zihuatanejo, Guerrero, Mexico. A 10-minute walk down the hill (including 74 steps) to the sandy beach of Playa La Ropa. The complex has overnight security staff and a gated entrance.

## Rates

$1,000–$2,500 USD per week, depending on season, duration, and occupancy. Minimum stay one week. High Season December–April; Low Season May–November. A $350/week cleaning fee, a $1,000 refundable damage deposit, and a $2,000 CAD reservation deposit apply. See [Rates](https://www.zihuatanejoplayaropacondorental.com/rates.md) for details.

## Booking

There is no online booking system. Contact host Oscar Mario Sanchez for availability and a quote: info@puntamarinazihuatanejo.com or +52 755 103 6035 (phone/WhatsApp). See the [Contact](https://www.zihuatanejoplayaropacondorental.com/contact.md) page for location and map details.

# About Playa La Ropa — Zihuatanejo, Mexico

Playa La Ropa is one of the most beautiful sandy beaches along Mexico's Pacific coast. Its gentle waves, warm waters, and scenic bay views make it a paradise for families, swimmers, and outdoor enthusiasts.

Depending on the season, you can witness pelicans diving for fish and local sea turtle releases. Activities on the beach include paddle boarding, Hobie Cat rentals, parasailing, jet-skiing, water rides for kids, snorkeling, and sailing.

## Beach information

- Beach type: fine white sand, very swimmable
- Distance from the condo: about a 10-minute walk down the hill
- Water temperature: broadly warm year-round
- Activities: snorkeling, sailing, paddle boarding, beach dining

## Local dining recommendations

The host's favorite local spots on or near Playa La Ropa:

- [Paty's Marymar](https://patys-marymar.com/): Beachfront al fresco dining, full bar, table service, wheelchair accessible. The host's favourite casual eatery and bar on the beach — smoothies, breakfasts, lunches, casual evening dining, and yoga in the upper salon most days.
- [La Gaviota](https://www.tripadvisor.ca/Restaurant_Review-g150795-d1032486-Reviews-La_Gaviota-Zihuatanejo_Zihuatanejo_de_Azueta_Pacific_Coast.html): Right on the beach, ideal for sunset dinners. Outside seating, full bar, credit cards accepted, free WiFi, family and dog friendly.
- [Jungle Pizza](https://www.tripadvisor.ca/Restaurant_Review-g150795-d1379281-Reviews-Jungle_Pizza-Zihuatanejo_Zihuatanejo_de_Azueta_Pacific_Coast.html): Just back from the beach across from the OXXO store. Delivery, takeout, outdoor seating, full bar. The host calls it the best pizza in town.
- [Trattoria da Gianni](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g150795-d7747587-Reviews-Trattoria_da_Gianni_Zihuatanejo-Zihuatanejo_Zihuatanejo_de_Azueta_Pacific_Coast.html): Italian bistro on the access road just behind Playa La Ropa. Indoor and garden seating, pasta and wine. Also on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/trattoriadagiannizihuatanejo).

# Rates & Pricing — Casa OM del Sur

## Weekly rental rates

$1,000–$2,500 USD per week. Weekly vacation rental prices vary depending on the season, duration, and occupancy. Ask for exact pricing for your dates.

- Minimum stay: one week
- High Season: December–April
- Low Season: May–November
- Sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably

Additional charges: $350/week cleaning fee, $1,000 refundable damage deposit, $2,000 CAD reservation deposit.

## What's included in the rate

- All linens, bath towels, and beach towels
- Access to the complex swimming pool and chaises
- Fully equipped galley kitchen and air fryer
- Water, gas, and electricity utilities
- Complex maintenance and night security guard
- High-speed WiFi internet access

## Booking & stay policies

- Contact the host to check availability. Reservations are finalized upon receipt of deposit.
- Cancellation, refund, and maximum-guest details are provided with your custom quote.
- Check-in/out times are flexible by arrangement.
- There is no online booking system. Contact host Oscar Mario Sanchez: info@puntamarinazihuatanejo.com or +52 755 103 6035 (phone/WhatsApp). See the [Contact](https://www.zihuatanejoplayaropacondorental.com/contact.md) page for details.

# Frequently Asked Questions — Casa OM del Sur

## How much does it cost to rent Casa OM del Sur for a week?

Weekly rates run $1,000–$2,500 USD, depending on the season: High Season is December–April and Low Season is May–November. The exact price depends on your dates and occupancy — contact the host for a quote.

## What is the minimum stay?

One week. Casa OM del Sur is a weekly vacation rental, so nightly stays are not available.

## How many guests can the condo sleep?

Up to 6 guests, in three king bedrooms.

## What is included in the weekly rate?

All bed linens, bath towels, and beach towels; access to the complex swimming pool and chaises; a fully equipped galley kitchen with air fryer; water, gas, and electricity; complex maintenance and a night security guard; and high-speed WiFi.

## Are there additional fees?

Yes: a $350 cleaning fee per week, a $1,000 refundable damage deposit, and a $2,000 CAD reservation deposit.

## How do I book Casa OM del Sur?

There is no online booking system. Contact host Oscar Mario Sanchez by email at info@puntamarinazihuatanejo.com, or by phone or WhatsApp at +52 755 103 6035. Reservations are finalized once your deposit is received.

## What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellation, refund, and maximum-guest details are provided with your custom quote — ask the host when you inquire.

## How far is the condo from Playa La Ropa beach?

About a 10-minute walk down the hill, including 74 steps, to the sandy beach.

## What are the bedrooms and bathrooms like?

Three king bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bathroom with a rain shower.

## When can we check in and out?

Check-in and check-out times are flexible by arrangement.
